flow: Register a Partner Center account under a domain email and primary Entra tenant, clear business verification, and join the free AI Cloud Partner Program.
Link the MPN ID to an indirect provider such as Ingram Micro, Pax8, TD Synnex or Sherweb, since direct bill now demands $1M trailing revenue.
Lock seat counts and term choice inside the 7-day NCE window, knowing monthly terms carry a 20% premium over annual.
Treat the 8-15% license margin as a floor and earn on the service layer by selling a complete solution, not just a license.

Enroll in Microsoft Commerce Incentives separately, clear the $25K trailing-12-month revenue floor plus a designation or 25 capability points, and file CPOR claims for a 60% rebate / 40% co-op payout.
Layer fixed-fee assessments, scoped builds and workflow-priced management on Copilot and Agent 365, giving every agent a named owner, least-privilege access and a credit limit.
